payload.summary: Planned the agent-ergonomic retrieval surface change. The review concluded the memory platform's multi-step operating loop is not the ergonomic gain for a single-owner system; four response-level properties are. Gate 1 selected Approach 1, clean contracts with cursors everywhere: exact search total with completeness and typed omissions, signed keyset cursors on search, insights, and MCP, a graph truncation flag, insight evidence plus maturity and single store, a pipeline dry run with a cost estimate, and the 19 ingest_* MCP tools collapsed into one registry-driven ingest tool. Owner confirmed a single consumer, so five breaking points are accepted. Coordinated tier, seven packages.

decisions.title: Search responses state completeness and typed omissions
decisions.rationale: Rerank, embedding, tree-search, and filter degradations were logged and dropped; an agent read a partial page as the corpus. SearchExecution threads facts into meta; providers are reported only when they contributed.

decisions.title: Exact total and signed keyset cursors replace offset
decisions.rationale: total was the fused candidate-window size and deep pages reshuffled; one deterministic ranking with an HMAC-signed cursor keyed by query digest gives stable pages across HTTP, MCP, and the frontend.

decisions.title: Insights carry maturity and supersession and are stored once
decisions.rationale: Regenerated digests made stale insights indistinguishable; the same insight was written to two tables. Memory holds a pointer and recall filters by maturity.

decisions.title: Pipeline dry run returns a PipelinePlan, not a persisted operation
decisions.rationale: plan_scheduled_commands is already pure; the plan carries the child manifest, the derived idempotency key, and a cost estimate that names its basis and uses ModelConfig.calculate_cost only.

decisions.title: One registry-driven ingest tool replaces 19 ingest_* tools
decisions.rationale: Schema tokens are paid every turn; the hand-written variants duplicated COMMAND_FIELD_SCHEMAS that get_capabilities already publishes. Manifest shrinks from 41 to 23 and cannot drift from SOURCE_REGISTRY.

decisions.title: Tier: coordinated
decisions.rationale: Coordinator reachable; packages split by boundary (search, insights, pipeline, MCP, frontend).

next_steps: Start with wp-contracts; then wp-search, wp-insights, and wp-pipeline-plan in parallel; wp-mcp after wp-search; wp-frontend after wp-search and wp-insights.
